name: Number of girls benefiting from the project
definition: Unduplicated count of adolescent girls who received at least one project-financed benefit during the reporting period.

name: Transition rate from primary to junior secondary school for girls
aliases: transition rate girls|primary to JSS transition
definition: Girls enrolled in JSS1 in the current year as a share of girls enrolled in Primary 6 in the preceding year, in project-supported schools.

name: Junior secondary school completion rate for girls
definition: Girls completing JSS3 as a share of the official JSS3 age cohort in supported LGAs.

name: Senior secondary school completion rate for girls
definition: Girls completing SSS3 as a share of the official SSS3 age cohort in supported LGAs.

name: Percentage of girls demonstrating improved learning outcomes
definition: Girls scoring at or above the proficiency benchmark on the state learning assessment, as a share of girls assessed.

name: Percentage of adolescent girls with improved digital literacy
definition: Girls passing the project digital-literacy assessment as a share of girls enrolled in digital skills programming.

name: Number of girls receiving conditional cash transfers
definition: Girls who received at least one conditional cash transfer payment during the reporting period.

name: Percentage of beneficiaries satisfied with project interventions
definition: Beneficiaries rating project services satisfactory or better in the most recent beneficiary feedback survey.

name: Number of new classrooms constructed
definition: Classrooms completed and handed over to the school during the reporting period.

name: Number of classrooms rehabilitated
definition: Existing classrooms restored to a safe and usable standard under project financing.

name: Number of schools with functional water points
definition: Supported schools with a water point verified functional at the time of the reporting visit.

name: Number of schools with girl-friendly sanitation facilities
definition: Supported schools with sex-segregated, lockable and functional sanitation facilities.

name: Number of schools with completed perimeter fencing
definition: Supported schools where perimeter fencing works were completed and certified.

name: Number of schools with functional electricity or solar power
definition: Supported schools with a functioning grid or solar power supply at the time of reporting.

name: Number of schools with menstrual hygiene management facilities
definition: Supported schools with a dedicated MHM space stocked with consumables.

name: Number of new schools constructed
definition: Complete new school facilities constructed and commissioned under the project.

name: Percentage of civil works contracts completed on schedule
definition: Civil works contracts reaching practical completion on or before the contractual date, as a share of contracts due.

name: Number of schools provided with furniture sets
definition: Supported schools that received project-financed pupil and teacher furniture.

name: Number of School Based Management Committees trained
definition: SBMCs that completed the project's school governance training package.

name: Percentage of SBMCs with at least 40 percent female membership
definition: Trained SBMCs whose membership register shows at least 40 percent women.

name: Number of schools with a functional school safety plan
definition: Supported schools with a documented, rehearsed and school-committee-endorsed safety plan.

name: Number of schools benefiting from school improvement grants
definition: Supported schools that received at least one school improvement grant tranche.

name: Value of school improvement grants disbursed
definition: Total value of school improvement grants disbursed to schools, in millions of naira.

name: Number of teachers recruited under the project
definition: Teachers newly engaged with project financing and deployed to supported schools.

name: Number of female teachers recruited under the project
definition: Subset of KPI-024 who are women; must not exceed KPI-024.

name: Number of teachers trained in gender-responsive pedagogy
definition: Teachers completing the project's gender-responsive pedagogy training package.

name: Number of head teachers and principals trained in school management
definition: School leaders completing the project's school leadership and management training.

name: Pupil-classroom ratio in supported schools
definition: Enrolled pupils divided by available classrooms in supported schools. A lower value is better.

name: Number of girls receiving scholarships or bursaries
definition: Girls who received a project-financed scholarship or bursary in the reporting period.

name: Number of girls enrolled in digital skills programmes
definition: Girls enrolled in a project-supported digital skills course during the period.

name: Number of girls enrolled in life skills and empowerment programmes
definition: Girls enrolled in the project's life-skills and empowerment curriculum.

name: Number of girls safe spaces or clubs established
definition: Safe spaces or girls' clubs formally established under the project.

name: Number of girls safe spaces or clubs assessed as functional
definition: Established safe spaces meeting the functionality criteria at the last assessment; must not exceed KPI-032.

name: Number of female mentors trained and deployed
definition: Women trained as project mentors and assigned to a safe space or school.

name: Number of community sensitisation campaigns conducted
definition: Community sensitisation events delivered on girls' education during the period.

name: Number of community members reached by sensitisation campaigns
definition: People reached in person by project sensitisation activities.

name: Number of religious and traditional leaders engaged as champions
definition: Religious and traditional leaders formally engaged as girls' education champions.

name: Percentage of targeted communities with an active girls education advocacy group
definition: Targeted communities with an advocacy group that met at least once in the period.

name: Number of out-of-school girls re-enrolled through second-chance programmes
definition: Previously out-of-school girls enrolled in a formal or non-formal learning programme.

name: Number of girls provided with school transport or transport stipends
definition: Girls receiving project-financed transport services or stipends.

name: Number of girls provided with learning materials or kits
definition: Girls who received a project-financed learning kit during the period.

name: Number of households receiving conditional cash transfer payments
definition: Households that received at least one CCT payment in the reporting period.

name: Value of conditional cash transfers disbursed
definition: Total value of conditional cash transfers paid to households, in millions of naira.

name: Percentage of CCT payments made within the scheduled payment window
definition: CCT payments executed inside the scheduled payment window as a share of payments due.

name: Number of girls trained in financial literacy
definition: Girls completing the project's financial literacy module.

name: Number of girls reached with health and life-skills education sessions
definition: Girls attending at least one project health and life-skills education session.

name: Reported child marriage cases among school-age girls in supported LGAs
definition: Child marriage cases reported through community and school channels. A lower value is better.

name: Number of boys engaged in gender norms change activities
definition: Boys participating in project activities addressing harmful gender norms.

name: Number of State PIU staff trained in project management
definition: State PIU personnel completing project management or fiduciary training.

name: Percentage of planned annual work plan activities implemented
definition: Activities completed as a share of activities scheduled in the annual work plan for the period.

name: Project disbursement rate
definition: Funds disbursed as a share of funds allocated for the period.

name: Percentage of annual work plan budget executed
definition: Budget executed as a share of budget appropriated for the period.

name: Number of EMIS data collection rounds completed
definition: Completed rounds of the state education management information system data collection.

name: Percentage of supported schools reporting into EMIS
definition: Supported schools submitting a complete EMIS return as a share of supported schools.

name: Number of data quality assessments conducted
definition: Formal data quality assessments completed at state or school level.

name: Average data quality assessment score of state reporting
definition: Mean DQA score across assessments conducted in the period, on a 0-100 scale.

name: Number of monitoring and evaluation officers trained
definition: M&E personnel completing project-financed M&E capacity training.

name: Number of supervision and monitoring visits conducted
definition: Field supervision or monitoring visits completed and documented in the period.

name: Percentage of monitoring visit action points closed
definition: Action points from monitoring visits closed within the agreed timeframe.

name: Number of procurement plans updated in STEP
definition: Procurement plan updates published in the Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement platform.

name: Percentage of procurement processes completed within standard timelines
definition: Procurement processes concluded within the standard timeline as a share of processes concluded.

name: Number of interim financial reports submitted on time
definition: Interim unaudited financial reports submitted on or before the due date.

name: Percentage of external audit findings resolved
definition: External audit findings closed as a share of findings raised.

name: Percentage of approved project staff positions filled
definition: Filled positions as a share of positions in the approved PIU staffing structure.

name: Number of grievances registered through the project grievance mechanism
definition: Grievances logged in the project GRM register during the period.

name: Percentage of grievances resolved within the stipulated timeframe
definition: Grievances closed within the GRM service standard as a share of grievances due for closure.

name: Number of GBV and SEA-SH cases referred to support services
definition: Cases referred to accredited survivor support services through project channels.

name: Percentage of supported schools with a functional GBV and SEA-SH reporting mechanism
definition: Supported schools with a confidential, publicised and tested reporting channel.

name: Number of environmental and social safeguards screenings completed
definition: Subproject safeguards screenings completed before works commenced.

name: Percentage of subprojects compliant with ESMP requirements
definition: Subprojects assessed compliant with their environmental and social management plan.
